offers_products.reason: Sells smart cutting machines, materials like vinyl and iron-on, tools and accessories.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is from machines and materials; the Design Space subscription is software, not work done for customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Crafters and DIY hobbyists buy machines and materials directly and through stores.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Retailers such as craft and mass-market stores buy Cricut goods for resale.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is repeat purchases of materials and accessories, plus subscriptions, rather than one-time machine sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Craft machines and materials are discretionary hobby purchases that households can postpone or cut.

big_ticket.reason: Materials and accessories are small, frequent purchases; machines cost a few hundred dollars.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured machines, materials and software, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are households and hobbyists, plus retailers reselling to them.

asset_heavy.reason: Designs products and software; manufacturing is largely outsourced, so growth needs little plant or fleet investment.

notes: Manufacturing outsourcing and revenue mix come from general knowledge, not the website text.
